profile: Arbutus Biopharma is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company focused on infectious disease. It is developing imdusiran, a subcutaneously delivered RNA interference therapeutic, and AB-101, an oral PD-L1 inhibitor, for chronic hepatitis B. The company also holds intellectual property related to lipid nanoparticle technology and pursues licensing and patent litigation activities concerning its use in mRNA vaccines.
